name: allura-memory-cowork
description: Search, store, manage, and curate Allura Brain memories from Cowork. Full suite of 10 canonical memory operations with hybrid vector + BM25 search, HITL curator approval, and governed promotion.

interface.shortDescription: Search, store, and curate AI agent memories via Allura Brain.
interface.longDescription: Allura Memory connects Cowork to your self-hosted Allura Brain instance. Search memories with hybrid vector + text ranking, store new memories with automatic scoring, manage the full lifecycle (update, delete, restore, export), and curate the promotion pipeline from episodic traces to canonical knowledge.
defaultPrompt: Search my memories for recent architecture decisions.
Remember this: we decided to use RuVector for hybrid search.
What memories are pending curator review?
